verdict.rationale: Raygun docs confirm ordering/prioritization of errors 'based on users affected and the number of occurrences' (raygun-docs-3), which supports blast-radius prioritization by users, but there is no explicit mention of sessions-affected metrics or a dedicated 'impact score' combining users and sessions as the story specifies. missing for 10: session-level impact quantification, explicit blast-radius/impact scoring beyond raw user+occurrence counts, independent confirmation of this prioritization workflow in practice.
